generate_ray_directions: generate normalized ray directions for a camera given width, height, field of view, and focal length
run_generate_ray_directions: run generate_ray_directions to compute a 3D array of normalized ray directions for rendering
test_generate_ray_directions: test generate_ray_directions by verifying output shape matches height times width times 3
review_generate_ray_directions: review generate_ray_directions to understand how it computes per-pixel ray directions using FOV and focal length
summarize_generate_ray_directions: summarize generate_ray_directions which creates normalized camera rays for NeRF rendering pipelines
